name: Virgo Global Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1999, Virgo Global Ltd is in the business of manufacturing, trading, and maintenance of computer hardware 
and software.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
VGL operates as an Internet Service Provider in India and is engaged in multiple activities. Its manufacturing, trading, and maintenance operations cover computer hardware, software, systems, assembled data processors, and program designs. On the commercial side, it deals in hardware and software packages, tabulating and accounting machines, calculators, and computerized telecommunication systems along with network components. Additionally, it provides supply and maintenance services for spare parts, equipment, and devices related to these technologies.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -13.2% over past five years.
Debtor days have increased from 49.7 to 61.2 days.
